title: Test case 7 — Culpable driving causing death while drunk (the mandatory licence order; a standard sentence)
shows: The orders that follow a driving offence: culpable driving causing death is a serious motor vehicle offence, so licence cancellation and disqualification for at least 2 years is mandatory, in the form a Victorian licence requires; it is also a standard sentence offence (8 years). The offender was intoxicated by liquor, but whether culpable driving is a “relevant offence” for an alcohol exclusion order is not plain from the Manual's categories, so the form leaves it unknown and the app shows a caution rather than deciding it.
